scraped.title: TVET Sector Support in Mozambique
scraped.subtitle: Support to the Mozambican Technical and Vocational Education and Training Sector (TVET II)
scraped.clientName: Secretaria de Estado do Técnico Profissional (SEETP / Secretary of State for Vocational Technical Education
scraped.description: The project “Support to the Mozambican Technical and Vocational Education and Training Sector (TVET)” is the second phase project of the framework of German Financial Cooperation (FC), which had been implemented between March 2017 and early 2023.
body: The project “Support to the Mozambican Technical and Vocational Education and Training Sector (TVET)” is the second phase project of the framework of German Financial Cooperation (FC), which had been implemented between March 2017 and early 2023.

This follow-up project focuses on further infrastructure and capacity development of the TVET institute (Instituto Industrial e Comercial da Beira, IICB) with a hub service function to other VET providers (formal and informal) and dual system partners in the northern provinces of Mozambique, in response to the demands of the private sector, and in cooperation with the national Institute for Professional Training and Labour Studies.

ICONs key support activities include the planning and design of infrastructure, addressing gender-specific and special needs as well as being climate resilient- and preserving heritage. Furthermore, ICON is involved in the technical planning, supervision, procurement and management of equipment for TVET facilities, school management and maintenance training, TVET curriculum development and practical training including the supervision of WBL, career orientation and counselling, ICT application, gender-sensitive coaching, implementation of environmental and social aspects and application of health and safety standards, as well as the provision of digital teaching and e-learning in the sectoral fields Electric/Electronic, Metal-Mechanic, Automotive, Civil Construction, Accounting.
